notes.title: MEGA DISCOUNT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667166/7bc0a0cb38dd5c825cdb4b21a0ea41ac48618714.png[/img]

Hello, another game update is out! Please ask everyone to update directly through the STEAM client, and to delete old saves before playing, to avoid any kind of conflict.


WHAT WAS ADDED?

- Game history has been changed.
- Notes for the scenario, tell more about the game.
- 2 new scenarios.
- improved graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667166/e3a0f05e73cda3f46f9a9ead12ccb0165715c27b.png[/img]

IS THE GAME COMPLETE NOW?

Yes, I told a brief story about a family
who suffered the consequences of living in a cursed place,
Centralia is the most famous ghost town, as it inspired the famous "Silent Hill".

RAFAEL, MORE THE GAME IS VERY SHORT!

Yes, it's a gameplay of 1 to 3 hours, it's not that short, but it's not a game that has a very long history.
The game is short, because I am the only developer of the game, occupying all technical and administrative functions.
I would love to show my work through this project!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667166/66021f0b4f972ce754251a075b2b152489d9cda9.png[/img]

MORE WHY SHOULD I BUY THIS GAME?

Simple my dear! to have a real horror experience! A game that involves Puzzles, Horror, Fear and a lot of Shooting!
Also, buying a game from an INDIE producer, you are helping the INDIE game market a lot, the best way to support small producers ... is betting on your work,
experimenting and giving a chance for something new!

If you like games in the style of horror and survival, then come on!

DO YOU WANT TO LAUNCH ANY MORE GAME?

Yes! I already have something in mind!

The sale of this game will be invested in my new project ...
I want something like the '80s, cult terror, those styles we love!
Soon I'll tell you more ...; D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36667166/3132f98780d4722637a976257ebd1e0653f4b5f0.png[/img]

Questions about the game? send me an email!

Questions: brazatattoo@outlook.com

Big hug! #INDIE
att Rafael Braza - 616 GAMES STUDIO.
